rationale: Separate from strict-visibility-decision1-v1. other-only means only the criminal namesake, so that person is present. An unrelated person is not other-only. Abstention is only for an uncommitted pair. It does not replace a committed win pair or a committed loss. This file does not change the v1 questions.

coverage.instructions: How is the supplied answer_text covered? Always choose one. answer-present means the text is a non-empty answer. no-answer means the text is empty because no answer was returned. aio-absent means the text is empty because an AI Overview was not shown. Do not leave this question unanswered.

criteria.no-answer: answer_text is empty because no answer was returned.
criteria.aio-absent: answer_text is empty because an AI Overview was not shown.

targetPrimary.instructions: Is answer_text primarily about the target engineer: a Kaleb Cole described as a software engineer or developer associated with Microsoft, Seattle, or kalebcole.com? Being first in a list of possible people is not primary. A disclaimer that a different person was involved in federal proceedings is not primary by itself. Use only answer_text. Always choose one.

criteria.true: The answer is primarily that engineer.
criteria.false: The answer is not primarily that engineer. A list of possible people is this, even when that engineer is listed first. An answer only about the criminal namesake is this.
criteria.unknown: The text does not establish it, including a greeting or account address with no engineer anchors.

criminalNamesakeMention.instructions: Does answer_text mention the other Kaleb Cole who was involved in federal proceedings connected to Atomwaffen Division? If the text is only about that namesake, choose true. Do not choose false only because the target engineer is absent. A clear accurate disclaimer that a different person was involved is a mention. A generic shared name, a Seattle locality card, or an unrelated athlete is not that person. Use only answer_text. Always choose one.

criteria.true: That other Kaleb Cole is mentioned, including an answer only about that namesake and an accurate disclaimer that a different person was involved in federal proceedings.
criteria.false: That other Kaleb Cole is not mentioned.
criteria.unknown: The text does not establish whether that other Kaleb Cole is mentioned.

identityClass.instructions: Who does answer_text describe? The target engineer is a Kaleb Cole described as a software engineer or developer associated with Microsoft, Seattle, or kalebcole.com. The criminal namesake is a different Kaleb Cole involved in federal proceedings connected to Atomwaffen Division. other-only means only that namesake, so that person is present. An unrelated athlete is not the criminal namesake, is not other-only, and is not both-separated. The target engineer plus an unrelated athlete, with no namesake, is target-only. Use only answer_text. Always choose one.

criteria.target-only: Only the target engineer. The criminal namesake is not mentioned.
criteria.other-only: Only the criminal namesake. That person is mentioned. An unrelated person is not this class.
criteria.both-separated: The target engineer and the criminal namesake both appear, and the text keeps them apart with an explicit separation or disclaimer.
criteria.conflated: The criminal namesake's federal-proceedings facts are attached to the target engineer without saying they are different people.
criteria.uncertain: The text is not enough to choose a class. An unrelated person who is neither the engineer nor the namesake is this, not other-only.
criteria.unknown: The text does not support a class.

harmfulAttribution.instructions: Does answer_text attach the criminal namesake's federal-proceedings facts to the target engineer without a separation? A clear disclaimer that a different person was involved is not harmful attribution. An answer only about the namesake, with the engineer absent, is not harmful attribution. Use only answer_text. Always choose one.

criteria.true: Those facts are attached to the target engineer without a separation.
criteria.false: Those facts are absent, they are only about the namesake, or they are clearly about a different person.
criteria.unknown: The text does not establish whether those facts are attached to the engineer.

citationSupport.instructions: Does answer_text present a citation offered in support of a claim about the target engineer? This is a label about the text only. It is not a check that a URL was fetched or is accurate. Always choose one.

criteria.true: The text presents at least one citation offered in support of a claim about the target engineer.
criteria.false: The text is about the target engineer and presents no such citation.
criteria.unknown: The text does not establish whether such a citation is present.
criteria.not-applicable: The text is not about the target engineer, or there is no answer.

positionDiagnostic.instructions: Where does the target engineer appear in answer_text? This label is diagnostic. It does not decide whether the answer is primarily about that engineer. First place in a list can be target-leads and still not be primary. Always choose one.

criteria.target-leads: The target engineer is the opening subject, or is first in a list.
criteria.target-mentioned-later: The target engineer appears after another person or topic leads.
criteria.target-absent: The text has no recognizable target-engineer description.
criteria.uncertain: The position cannot be told from the text.
criteria.not-recorded: No position label is being recorded.

abstained.instructions: Choose true only when at least one of targetPrimary and criminalNamesakeMention is unknown, so you are not committing to that pair. If both of those labels are true or false, choose false. Do not choose true instead of a clear loss. Do not choose true instead of a committed pair that the target is primary and the namesake is unmentioned. unknown is not false and is not scored as false. Always choose one.

criteria.true: At least one of targetPrimary and criminalNamesakeMention is unknown, so the pair is not committed.
criteria.false: Both of those labels are true or false. This includes a clear loss and a committed primary-and-unmentioned pair.
criteria.unknown: Cannot tell whether the pair is committed. This is not a false answer and is not scored as false.
